name: Inventory
blurb: Live stock across every location, with reorder worked out for you.

name: Logistics
blurb: Dispatch, transport and delivery on the same record as the order.

name: Integrated Finance
blurb: Ledgers that update as goods move, not at month end.
panelText: One ledger for every transaction — sales, purchases, payroll and stock movements post straight into the books, so your financial picture is never a day behind the business.

name: Payroll
blurb: Salaries, attendance and statutory deductions in one run.
panelText: Run payroll for any team size without spreadsheets — hours, leave, deductions and statutory contributions calculate automatically, every cycle.

name: POS System
blurb: Counter sales that hit the same stock record as everything else.
panelText: A fast, reliable checkout that talks to stock and finance the moment a sale happens — so what's on the shelf and what's in the books always agree.

name: Custom Modules
blurb: Built for the part of your operation nobody else has.
panelText: When none of the standard modules quite fit, we build the piece that does — designed to sit inside NexOne and share the same data as everything else.
benefits: Shares one database with core modules

name: Accounting
blurb: Bookkeeping handled by our team alongside the system.
panelText: Bookkeeping, monthly reports and tax filing handled inside the same system that runs your sales and stock — nothing to re-key at month end.

name: Web Development
blurb: Sites and portals built to work with your ERP data.
panelText: A website built around your brand and your business goals — briefed, designed and launched by a team that also builds the systems running behind it.

name: Digital Marketing
blurb: Campaigns run by people who know your product.
panelText: Reach the customers you're currently missing — campaigns planned, run and measured against real sales data, not guesswork.

name: Web Hosting
blurb: Managed hosting with monitoring and backups.
panelText: Fast, secure, managed hosting for your website and systems — monitored and maintained so uptime isn't something you have to think about.

name: Content Writing
blurb: Copy for your site, catalogues and campaigns.
panelText: Copy that sounds like you, written to convert — for your website, product listings, social posts and everything in between.
